name: 3D Perlin-Worley Noise Texture Generation
definition: A technique to generate procedural noise textures for volumetric clouds by combining low-frequency Perlin noise for broad cloud mass with inverted Worley (cellular) noise to carve hollows, producing a puffy cumulus appearance.
summary: This method generates 3D volumetric density maps for cloud-like structures by combining Perlin noise for mass with inverted Worley noise for cellular erosion.
